CH01.name: 罗砧
CH01.title: 狂战先锋
CH01.role: 近身压制 · 积怒狂暴 · 重斧连击

passive.name: 怒焰狂战
passive.description: 原始普攻有效命中每次攻击获得10怒气；主动技能首次有效命中获得8怒气；承受有效伤害获得5怒气，内置1秒冷却。满怒在有效战斗事件后自动进入8秒狂暴，本体伤害提高20%、普攻攻速提高25%、移动速度提高10%。结束后3秒锁定，不刷新时长。脱战5秒后每秒衰减10怒气。
passive.description_en: Confirmed original basics grant 10 Rage once per attack; an active skill grants 8 once per cast. Taking damage grants 5 with a one-second cooldown. At full Rage, a valid event triggers eight seconds of Berserk: +20% base damage, +25% basic attack speed and +10% movement speed. Rearm takes three seconds. Rage decays by 10 per second after five seconds out of combat.

CH01.original_visual: 成年先锋穿藏蓝银灰轻甲战装，朱红围巾与发光符文重斧组成清楚轮廓；金属包边和悬浮岩刃强调重量。
CH01.visual: 成年先锋穿藏蓝银灰轻甲战装，朱红围巾与发光符文重斧组成清楚轮廓；金属包边和悬浮岩刃强调重量。

upgrades.description: Q 怒气消耗 20 → 15；其他参数不自动增加
upgrades.description_en: Q Rage cost decreases from 20 to 15.

upgrades.description: W收势 0.26 → 0.18 秒；命中窗口不变
upgrades.description_en: Secondary recovery decreases from 0.26 s to 0.18 s; its hit window is unchanged.

upgrades.description: E 护盾授予 12% → 18% 最大生命；仍受共享上限
upgrades.description_en: E shield increases from 12% to 18% of maximum health, subject to shared shield caps.

upgrades.description: R 伤害 4.0H → 4.6H；不额外加大范围
upgrades.description_en: R damage increases from 4.0H to 4.6H; radius is unchanged.

A.name: 长轨
A.description: Q 距离 160 → 240，但伤害降至 1.2H；适合追击与侧切
A.description_en: Q distance increases from 160 to 240, but damage decreases to 1.2H. Better pursuit and flanking.

B.name: 地锚
B.description: Q 取消位移，改为自身半径 135 的 1.7H 冲击并获得 8% 最大生命护盾；失去接敌位移，适合守点
B.description_en: Q loses its movement and becomes a 135-radius impact around the player for 1.7H damage, granting an 8% maximum-health shield. Trades approach mobility for holding ground.

A.name: 定桩
A.description: R 伤害改为 5.4H，范围缩为 140，预备延长到 0.65 秒；需要精确制造窗口
A.description_en: R deals 5.4H damage, but its radius shrinks to 140 and preparation increases to 0.65 s. Requires a precise opening.

B.name: 清道
B.description: R 改为间隔 0.20 秒的两次 1.9H 波，每波范围 220，收势缩至 0.25 秒；同敌每波最多一次，只有第一波击退，总伤害低于标准 R
B.description_en: R becomes two 1.9H waves 0.20 s apart, each with 220 radius, and recovery decreases to 0.25 s. Each target can be hit once per wave; only the first wave knocks back. Lower total damage than standard R.

CH01.role_en: Close pressure · Rage berserker · Heavy axe combos
CH01.description: 近身进攻积攒怒气，满怒进入八秒狂暴。选择冲锋、重斩、防护或旋斩，在营地组合四个技能，持续压制敌人。
CH01.description_en: Build Rage through close combat and enter eight seconds of Berserk at full Rage. Equip four class skills at camp to combine charges, heavy cleaves, guards and spinning attacks.
CH01.visual_en: An adult male vanguard in navy and silver armor, a vermilion scarf and a giant crescent rune axe with an orange sun core and floating rock blades. Bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, high-angle three-quarter 2.5D silhouette.

CH02.name: 岑线
CH02.title: 游击快枪
CH02.role: 机动射击 · 精准装填 · 弹匣爆发

passive.name: 游击弹匣
passive.description: 普攻使用8发弹匣，弹体成功创建后消耗1发。空弹匣自动装填1秒；T可手动装填，第二次按键在45%～65%窗口内精准成功，填满弹匣并获得3发伤害提高20%的强化弹。每次装填只判定一次。成功完成闪避补2发普通弹并中止装填，不刷新强化弹。技能使用能量，不消耗普通弹匣。
passive.description_en: Basics consume one of eight rounds only after projectile creation. An empty magazine reloads for one second. Press the reload key again during 45–65% progress for a full magazine and three +20% enhanced basic rounds; each reload allows one attempt. A successful dodge ends the reload and restores two ordinary rounds. Active skills use Energy.

CH02.original_visual: 成年女性枪手穿米白青蓝短外套、少量珊瑚橙扣饰和利落高腰裤短靴；符文能量枪采用折叠枪管、轨道瞄具及青金发光枪口。
CH02.visual: 成年女性枪手穿米白青蓝短外套、少量珊瑚橙扣饰和利落高腰裤短靴；符文能量枪采用折叠枪管、轨道瞄具及青金发光枪口。

upgrades.description_en: Q Energy cost decreases from 25 to 20.

upgrades.description_en: Secondary damage against the second target increases from 65% to 100%; still at most two targets.

upgrades.description_en: Movement speed while firing R increases from 45% to 70% of base movement speed.

A.name: 掠风
A.description: Q 位移 150 → 230，每颗弹伤害 0.35H → 0.25H；用爆发换更远转位
A.description_en: Q distance increases from 150 to 230, but each shot decreases from 0.35H to 0.25H. Trades burst damage for repositioning.

B.name: 回射
B.description: Q 取消位移，在 0.26 秒内原地发射 3 颗各 0.55H 的弹；保留原预备与收势，失去脱身功能
B.description_en: Q loses its movement and fires three 0.55H shots from a stationary position over 0.26 s. Original preparation and recovery remain.

A.name: 锚轨
A.description: R 施放期间不能移动，每发改为 1.5H，允许额外穿透 1 敌且次目标承受 70%；取消仍可用空格，必须先造稳定窗口
A.description_en: R prevents movement, but each shot deals 1.5H and can pierce one extra enemy for 70% damage. A dash can still cancel; create a safe opening first.

B.name: 逐风
B.description: R 施放中移动速度为 100%，总发数减为 3，每发仍 1.2H；放弃站桩总量换移动追击
B.description_en: R permits movement at 100% speed, but fires only 3 shots of 1.2H each. Trades total burst damage for pursuit.

CH02.role_en: Mobile shooting · Precision reload · Magazine bursts
CH02.description: 围绕八发弹匣移动射击，精准装填获得三发强化普攻，闪避结束补两发普通弹。四个主动技能独立使用能量，可在营地自由搭配。
CH02.description_en: Move and fire around an eight-round magazine. Precision reload grants three enhanced basic rounds; a completed dodge restores two ordinary rounds. Four camp-selected active skills use a separate Energy resource.
CH02.visual_en: An adult female gunner in a fitted ivory and turquoise jacket, coral details, high-waisted trousers and short boots. Her gold-silver energy carbine has a cyan core and ring sights. Bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, high-angle three-quarter 2.5D silhouette.

CH03.name: 露弥
CH03.title: 暗黑魔法师
CH03.role: 单星灵协同 · 星辉协奏 · 防护控场

passive.name: 星辉协奏
passive.description: 固定星灵团团承担普攻表现，与露弥联合施法。战斗中每次主动技能第一次实际释放获得1层星辉，最多3层；满层后的下一次释放消耗3层，使该次基础伤害或护盾提高25%，回复10法力。8秒没有继续施法时消散；切房、死亡和回营清空。起手取消不获得或消耗，联合效果不重复触发。
passive.description_en: The single star companion Tuantuan shares the central basic attack. An active skill first released in combat grants one Starlight, up to three. The next release consumes all three for +25% base damage or shield and restores 10 Mana. Starlight fades after eight seconds without a release and clears on room change or death. Cancelled windups have no effect.

CH03.original_visual: 22岁成年女性，胸部丰满、腰线清晰、肩臂与腿部纤细匀称；浅栗卷发与可爱脸，大魔女帽、黑曜黑和午夜深紫束腰魔法裙、银色魔纹及幽蓝魔光。黑银星环法杖与暗紫水晶组成暗黑魔法师轮廓，唯一圆润四角星灵团团协同。
CH03.visual: 22岁成年女性，胸部丰满、腰线清晰、肩臂与腿部纤细匀称；浅栗卷发与可爱脸，大魔女帽、黑曜黑和午夜深紫束腰魔法裙、银色魔纹及幽蓝魔光。黑银星环法杖与暗紫水晶组成暗黑魔法师轮廓，唯一圆润四角星灵团团协同。

ultimate.summary_v2_en: Place a starfall field on a pack for repeated damage and slows.

upgrades.description_en: Q projectile speed increases from 650 to 850; range is unchanged.
Secondary node health increases from 35 to 50; node limit is unchanged.
E cooldown decreases from 11 s to 9 s.

A.name: 穿相
A.description: Q 不再爆炸，改为直线最多穿透 2 敌、各 1.0H 并施加感电；经过节点 90 内仍产生受限回声，失去圆形爆点
A.description_en: Q no longer explodes. It travels in a line through at most 2 enemies, dealing 1.0H and applying Shock to each. Passing within 90 units of nodes still triggers bounded echoes. Loses the circular blast.

B.name: 压相
B.description: Q 射程缩为 350，爆炸半径增为 100、伤害为 1.35H，冷却增至 6 秒；近距布置换区域收益
B.description_en: Q range decreases to 350, blast radius increases to 100 and damage becomes 1.35H, but cooldown increases to 6 s. Trades safe range for area coverage.

A.name: 定星领域
A.description: R 持续 7 秒，跳伤次数上限改为7次，每秒伤害0.65H，建场仍0.6H，理论总量5.15H；长驻阵地总量更高，但需要敌人持续留场
A.description_en: R lasts 7 s with up to 7 ticks of 0.65H each; its initial hit stays 0.6H. Maximum single-target total: 5.15H, requiring the target to remain in the field.

B.name: 随行领域
B.description: R 跟随玩家，半径降至140，持续4秒、最多4次跳伤，每秒0.65H，建场仍0.6H，理论总量3.2H；获得移动覆盖，显著牺牲范围与总量
B.description_en: R follows the player, with radius 140, duration 4 s and at most 4 ticks of 0.65H each; its initial hit stays 0.6H. Maximum single-target total: 3.2H. Trades radius and total damage for moving coverage.

CH03.role_en: Star companion · Spell chorus · Area control
CH03.description: 露弥与唯一星灵团团联合施法，三层星辉后下一次释放获得协奏强化。营地从十二个本职业技能中选择四个，组合攻击、防护与控场。
CH03.description_en: Lumi casts together with her single star companion Tuantuan. Three Starlight stacks empower the next release through Chorus. Select four of twelve class skills at camp for attacks, protection and area control.
CH03.visual_en: A cute 22-year-old adult dark mage with a full bust, defined narrow waist and slender proportionate arms and legs. Chestnut curls, a large witch hat, fitted obsidian-black and midnight-purple dress, silver magic patterns and spectral blue light. A black-silver star-ring staff holds a dark violet crystal; one rounded four-point star companion follows her. Hand-painted cartoon 2.5D, high-angle three-quarter view.
CH03.quick_start_v2: 主动技能实际释放积攒星辉，三层后的下一次释放强化伤害或护盾并回复法力。团团复用普攻入口；营地选好四个技能，整次出征配置固定。
CH03.quick_start_v2_en: Actual active releases build Starlight. The next release after three stacks boosts damage or shielding and refunds Mana. Tuantuan shares the basic attack; the four skills selected at camp stay fixed throughout the expedition.
